upload.dropTitle: Drop photos or folders to import
upload.dropHint: JPEG, PNG and AVIF — originals are stored untouched

status.duplicate: Already in your library — back in the inbox
status.merged: Already in your library — back in the inbox, place or file name added
status.restored: Restored from the trash — back in the inbox

inbox.subtitle_one: {{count}} photo waiting to become an artwork
inbox.emptyDescription: New photos sent from your phone or dropped here will wait in the inbox until you turn them into artworks.
inbox.createArtworksHint: Turn the selected photos into artworks with a frame style and a layout

photos.emptyDescription: Drop photos anywhere in this window, or pair your phone to send originals over Wi-Fi.
photos.createArtworksHint: Turn the selected photos into artworks with a frame style and a layout
photos.coversTvHint: Large enough to fill the TV without upscaling
photos.belowTvHint: Filling the whole TV would require upscaling

warnings.metadata_missing: No camera metadata: the file may have been converted or exported rather than sent as an original.
warnings.location_removed: The phone removed the GPS location before sending (Android does this for browsers), so no place can be shown.
warnings.possibly_downscaled: Low resolution: the phone may have sent a reduced copy.
warnings.below_tv_resolution: Smaller than 3840×2160: it cannot fill the TV pixel-perfectly.
warnings.high_bit_depth_reduced: 16-bit image: it is converted to 8-bit for display.

devices.subtitle: Browsers allowed to use this library
devices.pairDescription: Scan the QR code with the phone (same Wi-Fi network).

roleHints.uploader: Send photos and browse. Ideal for phones.
roleHints.admin: Full access, including editing and device management.

devices.scanHint: Or open the link below and enter the code:
devices.localhostNote: You are using the app from the machine running the server, so you are trusted automatically.
devices.emptyDescription: Pair your phone to send photos in full quality over Wi-Fi.
devices.name: Device name
devices.revokeConfirm: Revoke “{{name}}”? It will immediately lose access.

auth.setupDescription: Enter the setup code printed by the server at startup (or run `the_frame_v2 setup-code`).
auth.pairDescription: Enter the code shown on the desktop, or scan its QR code.
auth.notPairedDescription: On your computer, open Devices › Pair a device and scan the QR code with this device.

mobile.title: Send photos
mobile.pickHint: “Files” keeps the original file name. For the place too, send with the LocalSend app instead.
mobile.metaHint: Tags, collections and favorite are applied to the artworks you create from these photos.
mobile.noCollections: Collections will appear here once created on the desktop.
mobile.keepScreenOn: Keep this screen on until the upload finishes.

settings.artworkDefaultsHint: Frame style, layout and format used when creating artworks without choosing one.
settings.defaultRecipeHint: “Follow the photos” picks the layout for the number of photos selected, and shows a single photo whole.

comingSoon.title: Coming soon
comingSoon.description: This section is planned for Phase {{phase}} of the implementation plan.

errors.network_error: Network error. Check that you are on the same Wi-Fi network.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.forbidden: This device is not allowed to do that.
errors.unsupported_format_heic: HEIC photos are not supported. Set your camera to save JPEG.
errors.corrupt_image: The image file is damaged or incomplete.
errors.file_too_large: The file exceeds the upload limit.
errors.checksum_mismatch: The file was corrupted during transfer. Retry.
errors.upload_missing: The uploaded data was lost. Retry.
errors.ingest_failed: The photo could not be processed.
errors.host_not_allowed: This address is not allowed by the server configuration.
errors.too_many_photos: Too many photos for this layout.
errors.no_layout: No layout has that many slots.
errors.no_recipe: No composition holds that many photos.
errors.recipe_slot_count: This composition needs a different number of photos.
errors.layout_and_composition: Pass a layout or a composition, not both.
errors.version_conflict: The artwork was changed elsewhere. Reload it.
errors.artwork_incomplete: Fill every slot before marking the artwork ready.
errors.photo_missing: A photo used by this artwork is missing.
errors.render_failed: The artwork could not be rendered.
errors.transfer_interrupted: The transfer was interrupted. Send it again from the phone.

localsend.title: LocalSend
localsend.subtitle: Send photos from the LocalSend app: files arrive byte-for-byte, with their place and original name.
localsend.noDiscovery: not visible automatically: add it by IP address in LocalSend
localsend.howTo: In LocalSend on the phone, pick photos, then choose this receiver in “Nearby devices”. The first transfer from a new device must be allowed here.
localsend.empty: No device has used LocalSend with this library yet.
localsend.forgetConfirm: Forget “{{name}}”? Its next transfer will ask for approval again.
localsend.requestDescription: A LocalSend device that is not allowed yet is waiting for your answer.
localsend.requestHint: Allowing remembers this device: its next transfers are accepted automatically (you can block it in Devices). Only allow devices you recognise.

artworks.emptyDescription: Select photos in the Inbox and choose “Create artworks”.

tierHints.native: Every photo pixel is exactly one TV pixel
tierHints.downscaled: Photos are reduced to fit: full sharpness on the TV
tierHints.upscaled: At least one photo is enlarged: it may look soft on the TV

artworks.viewerHint: Server render at TV resolution. Arrow keys switch artworks.

create.title: Create artworks
create.summary_other: Creates {{count}} artworks (drafts), photos in selection order.
create.noRecipe: No built-in layout holds {{count}} photos, so they go one per artwork.

simple.attachHint: Pick a layout to arrange these photos automatically.
simple.noRecipe: No built-in layout holds {{count}} photos — arrange them by hand below.
simple.balanceInert: The format sets the proportions, so Balance has no effect here.
simple.effectiveHint: The margin is a minimum: the block is centred, so the space around it is larger.
simple.photoCell: Cell {{index}} — click to select, drag onto another to swap
simple.reframeHint: Drag the photo on the canvas to move it inside its cell.
simple.caption: Caption
simple.detached: The slots have been edited by hand, so this layout no longer drives them. Re-apply it to go back to the saved settings — undo brings your edits straight back.
simple.reapplyConfirm: The slots go back to the layout's own geometry. Your hand-made placement is one undo away.
simple.swapHint: Drag a photo onto another to swap them, or use the arrows.
simple.nativeHint: Zoom so the photo is shown pixel for pixel (no scaling).

mode.label: Editing mode
mode.betaWarning: Advanced tools are beta — free-form edits drop the layout link.

lock.label: Quality lock
lock.nativeHint: One photo pixel per TV pixel: the slot follows the crop
lock.freeHint: No constraint: the photo may be enlarged

alternatives.title: This photo is being enlarged
alternatives.description: It may look soft on the TV. Pick a way out, or keep it as it is.
alternatives.shrinkHint: Same crop, more mat around it

loupe.title: Loupe
loupe.hint: Move the pointer over the artwork to inspect it at 100%.
loupe.error: The region could not be rendered.

conflict.title: This artwork changed elsewhere
conflict.description: It was modified on another device while you were editing it.

commands.validate: Mark ready and go to the next
commands.fit: Fit the artwork to the view

slots.fitToPhoto: Fit the slot to the photo
slots.fillSlot: Fill the slot with the photo

arrange.sameSize: Same size as the last selected slot
arrange.applyDecorations: Copy bands, shadow and lock to the others
arrange.hint: Shift-click a second slot to align, distribute or resize them together.

templates.subtitle: Reusable looks and layouts. Artworks keep a copy: changing a template never changes them until you update them.
templates.builtinHint: Built-in templates cannot be edited — duplicate one first.
templates.name: Name
templates.emptyHint: Save a style or a layout from an artwork, or import a template file.
templates.pushUpdateHint: Apply the current “{{name}}” to every artwork made from it. Each one is snapshotted first, so it can be restored from its history.
templates.noUsage: No artwork was made from this template yet.
templates.saveAsStyleTitle: Save this look as a frame style
